status: not-run as a set. One dev case (v01) ran once on Claude Code as the routing smoke on 2026-10-28; see the package report. Nothing here is a measured misroute rate.
use: Copy `cases` into a westack-eval routing campaign (kind routing) and register it before any description is tuned. The split is fixed here: score the held-out cases once per description version; scoring them against a changed description turns them into dev cases.
population_needed: Names in `expect` must be in the campaign's population: westack-verify, westack-review and westack-debug from this repository, plus the user's gstack `review` and `qa` and the superpowers plugin's `superpowers:verification-before-completion`. westack-eval is manual-only, so requests to measure a skill expect NONE from a model-invoked router. While a sibling is not built, drop the cases that expect it rather than relabelling them.
